question: What is the name of the river formed by the confluence of Sankh River and South Koel River at Vedvyas in Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​The Brahmani River is formed by the confluence of the Shankh River and the South Koel River at Vedavyas in Odisha.**__

 __
 
• It flows through the districts of Sundargarh, Deogarh, Angul, Dhenkanal, Cuttack, Jajapur and Kendrapara.
 
• It forms a large delta with the Baitarani River before emptying into the Bay of Bengal at Dhamra.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Penna river **rises in the Nandi Hills in Chikkaballapur District of Karnataka state.
 
• **Subarnarekha river** originates near piska/nagri, near Ranchi, Jharkhand. It states of Jharkhand, West Bengal and Odisha.
 
• **Sabarmati river** originates in the Aravalli Range of the Udaipur District of Rajasthan. It flows through Rajasthan and Gujarat.
